name: Yumori β (Beta)
subtitle: Yumori beta builds
description: Beta builds of Yumori. Installs next to the normal app as Yumori β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: Yumori β
apps.subtitle: Yumori beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of Yumori. Installs next to the normal app as Yumori β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v2.0.0-beta+1

- Version tests: first beta is -beta+1
- Yumori v2.0.0: version 2.0.0; first betas start at -beta+1
- Rebrand to Yumori [preview]
- Yumori TV round 1: the Moonlit look on the TV
  - Colours: night purple background, Yumori card/surface, lavender highlights (Yumori palette is the default; "Your colour" still there).
  - Urbanist for all TV text.
  - Rail: tree mark (+ wordmark when open), no outline, fades into the page; lavender pill for the highlight; Browse (was Categories), new icons; clock.
  - Buttons and chips: lavender pills, outlined when off.
  - Cards: lavender progress line with a firefly, softer kind badge.
  - Player: Yumori loader while loading/buffering.
  - Banner/details fades go to night purple instead of black.
  - Settings menu and sources list highlight in lavender.
  - "AnymeX+" → "Yumori" on TV screens.
- Featured: picture ready before Home shows
  - Preload the first slide's picture into the disk cache before the hero shows.
  - Home's content waits for the hero's first picture (fades in), with a 7 s fallback.
  - Featured turned off counts as ready.
- TV (Flutter): Back button works (user-tested); drop the test wording
- TV runner: link libflutter_common.so through user_build.cmake (no weak refs)
- TV runner: weak references to the messenger functions (in libflutter_common.so, not linked directly)
- TV runner: talk over LG's C messenger API (C++ codec helpers aren't linked)
- TV (Flutter): ask webOS for the remote's Back button (test app)
- TV Home: rows start higher so a second row shows
- Stremio details eyebrow says MOVIE/SERIES [preview]
- Tighter Stats/Library header gap, taste buttons under action row, MOVIE/SERIES eyebrow, cheaper details blur [preview]
- Library: Everything is the default (Default list gone), Movies & TV titles can join custom lists via the shared list dialog; hide redundant Anime pills when manga is off [preview]
- Search: manga/novel search follows kMangaEnabled [preview]
- Hide manga/novel for now: tab, library/stats/extension filters, manga export (kMangaEnabled flag) [preview]
- Manga on iPhone: no title pill over the hero (wordmark, search, avatar like Home) [preview]
- Hero: poster-only art no longer stretched (blurred fill + sharp poster); long titles shrink [preview]
- Manga tab: same Featured hero as Home (trending manga, full-screen picture on PC) [preview]
- Welcome: hide Discord/Telegram until Yumori has its own links; stop pulling AnymeX invite links [preview]
- Extension Manager, Add-ons, Test pages: rounder Moonlit shapes [preview]
- Stats: even spacing, more room under header [preview]
- Stats: rounder cards, bigger numbers, pill progress bars [preview]
- Mouse drag only on media rows (not Featured); everything else fixed [preview]
- Mouse drag back on media rows; chips/tabs/pills not draggable [preview]
- Search: Movies/Series from TMDB with real paging (Cinemeta fallback); mouse can no longer drag-scroll lists/chips on desktop [preview]
- Search: keep loading more results as you scroll (anime pages + Cinemeta skip), fill short lists [preview]
- Search: anime + Movies/Series (Cinemeta) mixed, All/Anime/Movies/Series filter; settings groups all headed; top tab bar not draggable [preview]
- Settings: every page one tap away; maximize = borderless fullscreen; Browse tiles load in parallel + disk cache; Search restyle [preview]
- Featured on/off in Edit layout (default on); shorter PC rows (150x185 cards) [preview]
- Details shell: re-resolve poster colour after the frame, not during build [preview]
- Details: one shared shell (backdrop, theme, bottom bar, pill buttons) for AniList and Stremio pages [preview]
- Stremio details: same pill buttons and tab names as AnymeX details [preview]
- Revert "Details: Resume pill in hero, Episodes/Related/About/Comments tabs [preview]"
- Details: Resume pill in hero, Episodes/Related/About/Comments tabs [preview]
- PC: Featured picture reaches the very top; window buttons only show on hover [win] [preview]
- PC Home: Featured picture also behind the top bar; fades into the background on scroll [win] [preview]
- Windows preview: include hidden files (the .env was being dropped from the download) [win] [preview]
- About: say when .env did not load [preview]
- Test builds show their commit id in About [preview]
- Hero: fall back to the app's own trending list if the AniList request fails (Windows) [preview]
- TV CI: keep the extension bridge on the locked commit
- TV Home: picture fills the screen behind everything, shorter rows (168x252 / 320x180)
- Background: smoother, higher-res mesh (no blocky texture) [preview]
- Background mesh painted once into an image (fixes lag) [preview]
- Home hero always shows (ignore old Trending banner hide setting); lighter hero repaint [preview]
- iOS Home: wordmark title, hero fades into the page, bigger cards (160 x 232), lighter hero images [preview]
- Background: drawn blurred mesh gradient instead of the low-res image [preview]
- Featured: anime use TMDB art like the Movies & TV cards (AniList art as fallback) [preview]
- Phone cards: taller 2:3 posters (140 x 200) like the reference [preview]
- Professional look: straight Urbanist titles, calmer lavender/neutral accent, glows removed [preview]
- PC Home: full-screen Featured art behind the page, big title left, poster picker strip [preview]
- Hero: sharper art (poster on phone, big backdrop on wide), retry missing sources; no update prompt on preview builds [preview]
- Preview builds: ipa uploaded as-is, Windows no longer double-zipped [preview]
- Home: full-bleed mixed hero, no greeting/pill, drop list buttons + new-episodes card; Browse rename with Calendar/AI Picks; list exporters in profile [preview]
- Home: Featured banner as a hero above the greeting [preview]
- Library wide rows with progress line, Details pill buttons [preview]
- Category tiles: #1 title chip [preview]
- Windows: pushed pages start below the title bar [preview]
- For you uses normal cards, category tiles show first poster, search icon in top bar, drop row arrows and titlebar logo [preview]
- Fix Categories import [preview]
- Categories tab replaces Movies & TV tab; merged square For You row [preview]
- One merged For you row (anime + Movies & TV), square cards, second under Continue Watching
- Details header: eyebrow label and serif title [preview]
- Library/headers: serif titles, solid lavender pills, pill tab bar [preview]
- For You rows: wide cards with reason under each [preview]
- Stremio Continue Watching items always show a progress line (full when done, empty when not started) [preview]
- Fix import in Continue Watching card [preview]
- Continue Watching: wide cards with progress line and firefly [preview]
- Yumori Featured carousel style (default for new installs) [preview]
- Rebuild iOS preview [preview] [ios]
- Home: serif greeting, row titles with chevron [preview]
- Home header pill says Yumori
- Remove old Discord notice; firefly skeleton for poster placeholders [preview]
- Progress ring on card chips; steady type bar on Repositories tab [preview]
- Preview build: Yumori round 2 [preview]
- Default theme: Moonlit surfaces, lavender primary, Playfair display titles
- Details placeholders use the Yumori skeleton; drop the shimmer package
- Update test for renamed error-log header
- Rename visible AnymeX/AnymeX+ text to Yumori (leaving data paths, formats and Discord)
- Cleanup: remove custom-logo, logo animation, donation code and old AnymeX logo files
- Extensions: Installed / Available / Repositories tabs
- Settings: 10 tabs on the landing page, hub pages for tabs with several categories
- Icons: crop the artwork's dark margin so the rounded edge fills the icon [preview]
- New Yumori app icons (iOS, Windows, Android, macOS, web) [preview]
- About: Yumori name and links, credits to AnymeX and Stremio
- Remove donation page/pop-ups and Logo Animation setting; Yumori name in titlebar, header, welcome
- Top bar uses the Yumori wordmark image [preview]
- Round 2 preview build [preview]
- Splash and all in-app logos show Yumori (loader / tree mark)
- Windows: Yumori top bar replaces the side rail
- Carousels show placeholder cards with a drifting firefly while loading [preview]
- Carousels and home rows load with the fireflies only [preview]
- Loader: fireflies only (no tree) when small, e.g. in rows
- Yumori round 1 preview build [preview]
- Preview build: run from a wip push with [preview] in the message
- Add a manual preview build (iPhone + Windows) that never releases
- Yumori round 1: tokens, firefly loader, progress ring, nav orbit
- TV (Flutter): Yumori test palette
- TV (Flutter): glint speed setting, slower by default
- TV (Flutter): glints go the same way on opposite sides; pick their second colour
  - The two glints now travel round together, half a lap apart.
  - Settings → Appearance → Second colour: Auto (a hue next to your accent) or any of AnymeX's colours; the glints fade from your accent into it (KV plus_tv_ring_second).
